title: Copy That Floppy – Cambridge guide for preserving data from fragile floppy disks
summary: A practical guide from Cambridge University providing best practices and methods for preserving data from fragile, aging floppy disk media before they degrade permanently. The guide focuses on proper techniques for reading, copying, and archiving floppy disk contents as part of digital preservation efforts.
problem_solved: Prevents permanent data loss from deteriorating floppy disk media by providing systematic preservation workflows
why_valuable: Floppy disks are inherently unstable magnetic media that degrade over time; this guide offers essential techniques to rescue irreplaceable historical data before it becomes unrecoverable
